issues.title: Missing GWT for Archetype Pipelines
issues.why: While the overview has ACs, the specific behaviors of the Browser Extension and Go Binary pipelines (e.g., source map removal, SHA-dedup logic) lack individual GWT acceptance criteria.
issues.fix: Add specific GWT criteria to 97-acceptance-criteria.md for the build-graph logic and packaging constraints.

issues.title: Ambiguous Module Path Placeholders
issues.why: The Go build commands use '<module>/version' placeholders which an AI might implement literally or fail to map to the actual repository structure.
issues.fix: Explicitly define that '<module>' must be replaced with the module name from go.mod.
